plan.mission_statement: To roast and serve exceptional coffee while building a fair, transparent supply chain with our growers.
plan.vision_statement: To be the most trusted specialty coffee roaster in the Pacific Northwest by 2030.

executive_summary.overview: Cedar & Stone Coffee is a specialty coffee roaster and cafe focused on direct-trade sourcing and small-batch roasting for wholesale and retail customers.

objectives.name: Open flagship cafe
objectives.description: Open our first retail location in Portland, OR within the first year of operation.

objectives.name: Wholesale expansion
objectives.description: Sign 25 wholesale accounts with local restaurants and grocers by end of year two.

market_analysis.target_market: Urban professionals aged 25-45 who value ethically sourced, high-quality coffee.
industry_trends: Growing consumer demand for direct-trade and traceable sourcing
Increased interest in low-waste and reusable packaging
customer_demographics: Urban and suburban Portland metro area

marketing_plan.unique_value_proposition: Direct-trade, small-batch coffee roasted within 48 hours of order.
marketing_plan.pricing_strategy: Premium pricing justified by direct-trade sourcing and freshness guarantee.
marketing_plan.sales_strategy: Combination of direct retail sales, e-commerce subscriptions, and wholesale accounts.
marketing_plan.branding_strategy: Warm, craftsmanship-focused branding emphasizing origin stories and grower partnerships.

financial_plan.break_even_point: Expected to break even in month 14 based on projected wholesale growth.

operations_plan.facilities: 3,500 sq ft roasting facility with attached retail cafe

suppliers.name: Finca Los Robles
suppliers.description: Direct-trade green coffee supplier in Huila, Colombia

operations_plan.workflow: Green coffee is received weekly, roasted to order within 48 hours, and shipped or served fresh.

core_values.name: Transparency
core_values.description: We disclose what we pay growers and how we price our coffee.

core_values.name: Craftsmanship
core_values.description: We treat every batch as an opportunity to improve our roast profiles.
